base.description: Home of the wanderers. Three captured destroyers and a Nebula freighter welded into a mobile station the locals call 'the Patchwork.' Nothing matches, everything is jury-rigged, and the water on Decks 7 through 12 tastes like reactor coolant — but it flies, it fights, and the docking bay is open to anyone who doesn't start trouble.
base.name: Frontier Station

condition.condition_text: Multiple systems running on emergency reserves. Lights flicker in the corridors.
